body_md:
To settle permanently or become a British citizen, most adults must show they know about life in the UK and can speak English.

Most people do this by passing the **Life in the UK test** and meeting the **English language requirement**. Some people do not need to take the test, for example people aged 65 or over.
key_facts: Most applicants must pass the Life in the UK test
Applicants must also meet the English language requirement
People aged 65 or over do not need to take the test
